text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Mile CS. In the stands, 
Mejiro Palmer, K.S. Miracle, and Daiichi 
Ruby are in da building.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having failed to produce results on the 
Tiara Route that was supposed to be worthy 
of the "Clan"... Daiichi Ruby was told by 
her mother to pivot to the sprint 
division, leaving her feeling totally 
down.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, Daitaku Helios was totally 
hyped with all her fave people gathered 
around! She laid it on thick, telling 
Bamboo Memory she was gonna hit 'em with 
all her love.
